notes: No official register of clinics with public contact data was found: PVMA site has no clinic directory, and the Bureau of Animal Industry and PRC were not usable for this (BAI pages found concern disease reporting and permits). No Philippines animal poison line was found. The National Poison Management and Control Center (UP-PGH, +63 2 8524 1078 per upm.edu.ph) serves people; the page opened does not say it takes animal cases, so it is not listed. PAWS' FAQ states it has no 24-hour hotline. No duty rotas found. Refused or unreachable: davaoemergencyvethospital.com (fetch failed twice, client_error; Davao 24/7 claim only seen in search results, not used), animalwellness.ph (robots), Facebook pages of Serbisyo Beterinaryo branches and Cebu clinics (robots), spot.ph 24-hour list (fetch failed), petsunitedvet.com (Boracay/Palawan; redirect loop), pendragonvet.com home and makatidogandcathospital.com (not permitted by fetch provenance). Needs follow-up: Makati Dog and Cat Hospital (press says open 24 hours for emergencies, no own page opened, no phone from an opened page), Petlink Wellness Center Caloocan ('24 hours' only in a 2020 Inquirer list), Serbisyo Beterinaryo and Pet Hub branch-level addresses/phones and which branches are 24 h, Davao Emergency Veterinary Hospital, UP VTH hours and phones, Cebu Veterinary Doctors conflicting Sunday hours and Mactan phone. Not covered: Baguio, Boracay, Palawan, Siargao and most of Mindanao and the Visayas outside Cebu.
